title: No Lan Button
description: Removes the "Open to Lan" button on the in-game menu
body:
If you’re like me and you abuse the “Open to LAN” button to enable cheats in your survival world—whether it’s to spawn items, speed up builds, or take shortcuts—and then regret it later, this mod is for you!

This mod disables the LAN button from the pause menu, so you can stick to the rules you set when creating your world. No more sneaky cheat toggling, no more post-build regret—just a fair, consistent survival experience.
